findings.claim: TrendForce 預估 2026 年前十大晶圓代工 8 吋平均稼動率近 90%（2025 約 80%），全球 8 吋產能至 2027 上半年續呈負成長
findings.excerpt: The average 8-inch capacity utilisation rate among the world's ten largest foundries is projected to approach 90% in 2026, up from around 80% in 2025; TrendForce expects global 8-inch capacity to remain in negative growth through the first half of 2027.

findings.claim: 成熟製程晶圓代工 2026 Q1→Q2 全面漲價 5–15%，第三輪漲價可能從 2026 下半年延續到 2027
findings.excerpt: The industry is also preparing a third round of price increases that could extend from the second half of 2026 into 2027.

findings.claim: 12 吋擴產近 70% 來自中國晶圓廠，其餘地區擴產溫和；TSMC 縮減 12 吋成熟產能預期將轉單給其他代工廠
findings.excerpt: Nearly 70% of capacity expansion in this segment is being driven by Chinese foundries, while expansion elsewhere remains moderate.

findings.claim: TrendForce 2023 年預測中國成熟製程產能占比 2027 年達 39%，並警告 CIS、DDI、PMIC、功率離散元件可能價格競爭（舊預測，早於 2026 年緊俏）
GF 管理層：通訊基礎建設與資料中心營收年增 62%，預期 2026 年該區塊成長 50–60%，矽光子營收翻倍以上；SiGe 產能至 2027 已超額訂購並擴產
GF 2026 Q2 財報電話會議：車用與智慧行動營收轉弱，家用與工業 IoT 改善
UBS 逆市場共識認為成熟製程晶圓代工進入上行週期（供給重分配驅動），預期 2027–2028 獲利更有上檔
findings.excerpt: Earlier, UBS put forward the opposite view from market consensus, that the mature process foundry industry will usher in an upward cycle, which is driven by the reallocation of supply and resources throughout the industry.

findings.claim: 消費性電子受記憶體漲價與零組件成本拖累，2026 下半年出貨承壓，部分客戶希望延後漲價
